title: nan
authors: MA B.; LIU Z.; JIANG F.; ZHAO W.; DANG Q.; WANG X.; ZHANG J.; WANG L.
key_contribution: Presents a LiDAR-based formation localization algorithm using k-means vector matching integrated with a reinforcement learning controller for close-formation UAV flight in GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Multi_Agent_Collaborative_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
